correctness.rationale: For all q congruent to 1 mod 9, the group mu3 is contained in K, so a_u=u^k c(u) gives independent K multipliers on the three fibers. f is automatically bijective, while f+X bijectivity is equivalent both to nonzero 1+a_u and to a three-coset permutation. Exactly three shifts are constant, and three are nonconstant permutations. Character orthogonality and the mixed Jacobi sum -1 give 9N_j=q-4+z*zeta^{-j}+conj(z)*zeta^j. The Gauss/Jacobi identity |J|=sqrt(q) gives N_j>0. The cubic identity produces R-T=(q-4)|J-2|^2/27; its strictness follows |J|>2. Elementary symmetric expansions and s=(q-1)/3 give the stated error terms. The standalone exact checker independently exhausts f and f+X for all coefficient triples at q=19,37,64,73 and recomputes local character identities for eight fields; all passed. Finite examples are not used as universal proof.

value.rationale: The 2026 scalar CPP paper constructs only constant-shift examples, motivating the unanswered full-class spectrum. Counting all c rather than selected examples and discriminating rotations from transpositions yields a strict, exact arithmetic bias controlled by a cubic Jacobi squared norm and sharp order q^2/27. The universal normalized 2/9 - 5/(3q) correction quantifies density beyond the qualitative existence criteria. This is a natural global invariant for the source family, not an arbitrary index table or a mere restatement of its criterion. No broader theorem is required for its intrinsic value.
